text: Databricks & Delta Lake Lessons 48 through 57 already introduced Lakeflow and the Delta Live Tables rename in full. Here's what's changed since, and what this chapter actually adds.

Lesson 48 named the DLT-to-Lakeflow rename. Since then, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines has moved onto the open-source Apache Spark Declarative Pipelines engine, and the Python module changed from dlt to pyspark.pipelines, imported as dp.

The comparison that actually matters here: Lakeflow's declarative pipelines against the manual bronze-to-silver-to-gold pipeline this track built by hand — same destination, dependency order inferred instead of wired by hand.

Lesson 13 covers the real SQL and Python syntax. Lesson 14 gives the honest trade-off against a traditional notebook. Lesson 15 adds Expectations' SQL side. Lesson 16 covers deployment with Databricks Asset Bundles.
Same engine Lesson 48 named, one more rename further along. Next up: the real syntax behind a streaming table and a materialized view.
